featured_reviews.review_text:
We had our destination wedding in Udaipur, India, and the overall experience with the team was a mix of highs and lows. However, the owner was disappointing to work with, mainly due to a lack of transparency and support when dealing with vendors. They did not assist in negotiating with key vendors, especially the venue, which was one of the most expensive aspect of our wedding. We expected better advocacy on our behalf, but unfortunately that did not happen.

Additionally, the team could greatly benefit from improved IT solutions to streamline planning, communication, and logistics. A more structured approach would enhance their efficiency.

Having said this, we would like to thank the whole team for making our day extra special. Thank you!
